facts: Parties: Pemberton Software Ltd (Buyer), Orwell Holdings Ltd (Seller); the Company is Kestrel Marine Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 23 April 2026; Closing is scheduled for 27 May 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 20 days of becoming aware of it.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 24 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 72 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 24 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Holloway Systems Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
